title: External-Review Advocate Verdict
description: The payload a PRO / CON / single advocate returns for ONE finding in the external-review pattern. This file defines the SHAPE and value domains ONLY; the advocacy SEMANTICS (PRO argues real defect, CON argues false-positive, judge against the bound standard-*) live in flow-external-review + the advocate's bound review standards. `severity` is the ONE anchored scale (see severity.schema.json). Return ONLY an object conforming to this schema.

verdict.description: The advocate's ruling on the finding.
verdict.$comment: Documented 4-value SUBSET of finding-verdict.schema.json. Advocates CANNOT emit ALREADY_RESOLVED or ESCALATE — those are arbiter-only calls (see finding-verdict.schema.json). $ref is not used here precisely because the advocate domain is narrower than the full arbiter set.

recommended_action.description: The default to apply. REQUIRED for a technical call.

confidence.description: The advocate's stated confidence in its position.
